prompt: Create a production 2D dark fantasy RPG character sprite sheet using supplied reference images ONLY as character identity/pose references, NOT as background or layout. Character: original hooded cave assassin, full dark purple-black fitted layered leather ninja armor, masked mouth, icy pale-blue eyes, pointed purple hood, dark belt with rectangular pouches, forearm wraps, dark calf boots; ALWAYS holds TWO short curved steel daggers, one per hand, never a bow. Very restrained blue flame wisps behind shoulders. Match illustrated painterly/pixel-detailed game sprite style and anatomy in reference, no horns, wings, white hair, cape, extra weapons or character redesign. Sheet is EXACTLY 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 separate full-body poses, equal cells, ideally 2048x1536 canvas. Each figure approximately same head-to-feet height, feet near 82% of its cell height, plenty of transparent margin (at least 10%) around weapons and effects, completely isolated, no touching between cells. No lines, frame borders, grid, checker pattern, text, labels, symbols or title banner. GENUINE TRANSPARENT RGBA background, not drawn checker. No ground shadow or dirt, only sparse character-attached effects. Silhouette and limb actions must read at tiny 48px. Walk row1 frames1-4: left-foot-forward stride, passing step with heel raised, right-foot-forward opposite stride, opposite passing step, clearly four different arm/leg poses with both daggers visible. Attack row2 frames1-4: 1 low coiled windup with both daggers pulled back, 2 forceful first dagger sweep with thin GREEN blade arc, 3 opposite-hand crossing follow-up sweep with different torso/arm pose and thin GREEN arc, 4 recovery to crouched two-dagger guard. Cast/hit row3: col1 gather magic with both arms lifted and blue-violet swirl, col2 release magic with hands/daggers spread and contained blue flame rising, col3 recoil from hit bending torso backward with small orange spark at shoulder, col4 recover into low defensive stance. All 12 must be individually drawn different poses, do not repeat a cell. Consistent character body proportions, camera angle, lighting and design in every cell. All 12 poses face DOWN toward viewer, front three-quarter game view (see mask and TWO eyes), feet generally toward bottom; view from slightly above. Reference 8-1 is FRONT action/identity guide.
